name: Tamil Pudhalvan
summary: ₹1,000 a month for boys who went to a government or aided Tamil medium school and are now in college.
benefit_note: Paid by direct transfer until he finishes his first higher education course. There is no limit on how many boys in one family can receive it.
how_to_apply: Enrol in a recognised degree, diploma or ITI course.
Your college registers you for the transfer.
The college certifies that you are still studying twice a year, on 30 June and 31 December.

Taken from the Tamil Nadu Social Welfare Department page on 2026-08-09. Every source_quote is wording from that page.

NOT IDENTICAL TO PUDHUMAI PENN. Two real differences, easy to miss when copying the file: this scheme also accepts GOVERNMENT AIDED schools, and it requires TAMIL MEDIUM. Pudhumai Penn says only 'Government schools' with no medium condition. Do not harmonise them.

TO CONFIRM: the exact scope of 'in tamil medium'. The sentence reads 'Government schools and Government aided schools in tamil medium', which could mean the medium condition applies to both school types or only to aided schools. It is written here as applying to both, which is the stricter reading — so the risk is a false negative rather than a false positive. Settle it against the government order.
